title: Industry Night: Meet the Actuaries
description: Hear from actuaries at insurers and consultancies about their day-to-day work, then stay for pizza and a networking hour.

title: Exam P Workshop
description: A guided problem session on probability for anyone preparing for the first exam.

title: Pizza & Problems
description: Drop in for lunch and work through a few puzzle-style problems with other members.

title: Resume Critique Night
description: Bring a printed or digital resume. Execs and alumni give one-on-one feedback.

title: OPG Session 1
description: The first pricing session of the Open Pricing Game. Teams receive their book of policyholders and submit their first rates.

title: Mentorship Kickoff
description: Meet your mentor or mentee, with icebreakers and a short guide to making the most of the program.

title: Case Competition Weekend
description: A three-day insurance case competition for teams of up to four. Cases are released Friday morning and presented on Sunday.

title: OPG Session 2
description: Second pricing session. Teams see how the market moved and update their rates.

title: OPG Final Session
description: Final pricing round, followed by the results reveal and awards.

title: Welcome Back Social
description: Games, snacks and a chance to meet this term's exec team.

title: Winter Industry Panel
description: A panel of recent graduates talking about their first years in the industry.
